messages:
marta: Heads-up — discovered a small set of spans that contain unredacted user identifiers (emails) from the new routing debug exporter. We need to decide retention + key/access plan before we flip it to prod.
ajay: can you paste an example span attr? is it full prompt or just metadata like user_id/email?
marta: found attrs: user.email, route.debug_info, request_body.preview (truncated). Example: user.email=alice@example.com. Not the whole prompt, but enough to PII-match.
jules: ugh. For GDPR and SOC2 we should treat user.email as personal data. Two options: redact at collector, or encrypt at rest with per-customer keys + strict KMS ACLs. Redaction loses observability.
lex: infra-bot: current export pipeline: otelcol -> kafka -> longterm-exporter. Longterm-exporter writes to s3-telemetry bucket (30d lifecycle). Exporter config snippet we use: ```exporters:
  s3: {
    bucket: "telemetry-raw",
    path: "spans/"
  }
```
amart: (typo) meant marta :)
ajay: if we encrypt with envelope keys and restrict KMS usage, we can keep full fidelity for a short window (e.g., 7d) and then redact for long-term. That balances debugging vs compliance. Who manages the key ACLs?
jules: Security should own KMS policies. But note: deterministic pseudonymization (HMAC of email with salt) could let us still correlate users without storing raw PII. However that may still be considered personal data under some regs.
security-bot: FYI: security policy requires private telemetry containing PII to be either (a) encrypted w/ customer-scoped keys OR (b) redacted before leaving the customer's control plane. See internal doc: https://redwood.infra/security/telemetry-pii
lex: infra-bot: we can do exporter-side filters in the collector pipeline. Quick patch to collector to drop user.email and request_body.* before serializing is trivial. But route.debug_info helps ops — maybe we only drop email but keep route.debug_info.
marta: prefer to keep debug_info. My ask: short-term plan to allow canary of routing-debug exporter with email pseudonymized + 7d raw retention, then full redaction after SLO window. Need key access model and audit trail.
ajay: proposal: 1) Pseudonymize at collector using HMAC-SHA256 with rotation salt stored in KMS (access only to collector service account). 2) Keep raw for 7d in encrypted bucket (KMS envelope) with access logs forwarded to SIEM. 3) After 7d run a redaction job that replaces user.email with <redacted>. 4) Key rotation quarterly, and emergency rotation procedure documented.
jules: Concern: HMAC salt rotation requires re-hashing to correlate old->new. Might lose long-term correlation. If we want stable pseudonyms for A/B, consider stable per-customer salt stored under customer key.
lex: infra-bot: operational notes — implementing HMAC in collector adds ~0.5ms per span CPU. Should be fine at current QPS but needs perf test on canary.
security-bot: add audit requirement: all KMS decryption calls for telemetry must log caller+purpose to audit log and trigger alert on unexpected principals. Also require quarterly access review for telemetry-key roles.
marta: ok. Action items: @ajay to prototype collector HMAC pseudonymization + canary config. @lex to add short-lived encrypted retention lifecycle (7d raw -> redact). @jules + security to draft key ACL and audit playbook. Target: canary in 2 weeks.
ajay: noted — I'll open infra ticket and attach unit perf tests. Ticket: infra-1907.
jules: I'll draft ACLs and a runbook. Need legal sign-off on pseudonymization approach (whether it's 'sufficient' under GDPR).
lex: I'll wire exporter pipeline to use a separate s3 prefix "telemetry-pii/raw-canary/" and set lifecycle to 7d. After 7d, a lambda will run redaction job that rewrites objects to redacted prefix.
marta: thanks. One more ask — ensure anyone who runs redaction job cannot retrieve raw objects (separate role + temporary access).
security-bot: confirmed: redaction role will have kms:Decrypt for the enclave key and s3:PutObject to write redacted copy but not s3:GetObject on raw prefix. Audit logs enabled.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: collector canary config pushed to staging. Runbook link: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/telemetry-pii-canary
ajay: started PR: https://git.redwood/infra/collector/pulls/482 — includes HMAC helper and config flag `pseudonymize_user_email: true`.
jules: legal pinged for GDPR assessment.
marta: closing the thread for now — will update when canary metrics show no perf regression and legal OK. :lock:
